headline: Small clean ESE — the best of a tiny week out east.
today: Waist-high ESE at fair angle with light NNW offshore in the morning, so it's clean and rideable if undersized. Nothing worth a 2.5hr drive, but if you're near Montauk it's a fun log or fish session on the morning tide before the E cross fills in by evening. Fade the afternoon as the tide drops out.

daysToWatch.note: Wind cranks to 23mph then 29mph SW — fully blown. Stay home.
The pick of the week here: 2-3ft SSW at a good angle with N offshore in the morning. Cleanest size we've got — this is the drive if any day is.
